# PM Transcripts (pmtranscripts.pmc.gov.au) - transcript ids for aus_pmtranscripts.yml.
#
# Each line is the XML API URL for one transcript. The human-facing page for id N is
#   https://pmtranscripts.pmc.gov.au/release/transcript-N
# The API is used instead because it carries title / prime-minister / date / release-type
# as single-match elements, which the HTML page does not.
#
# GENERATED by recipe_tools/pmt_index.py, which walks the site's own listing pager
#   https://pmtranscripts.pmc.gov.au/?text=&items_per_page=100&page=N
# and collects every /release/transcript-<id> link. This is the site's complete index, so
# the list is the whole collection rather than the subset the Internet Archive crawled.
# Regenerate by re-running that script.
